HZDR Spin-off Siderogain enters the market

With a biotechnological process for recovering critical metals from industrial wastewater, Siderogain transfers a biotech process from research to business. The spin-off originated in the biotechnology department of the Helmholtz Institute Freiberg for Resource Technology (HIF) at the Helmholtz-Zentrum Dresden-Rossendorf (HZDR).

Since August, the spin-off has also been receiving funding from the EXIST Research Transfer program.
